decisive_items: bilateral opacification of the sphenoid and ethmoid sinuses
left intraorbital involvement with contrast enhancement
extension into the cavernous sinus causing pachymeningeal enhancement
response.rationale: Immunosuppression (prednisone 80 mg daily) plus rapidly progressive orbital and intracranial extension from sinus opacification strongly favors invasive fungal sinusitis over other candidates.

rejected.why: Tolosa-Hunt is idiopathic cavernous inflammation, lacks sinus opacification and immunosuppression context.
Orbital cellulitis typically follows sinusitis but less likely with bilateral sinus involvement and cavernous extension in an immunocompromised host.
Metastatic disease possible given breast cancer history, but imaging pattern of sinus opacification and extension is more typical of infection.
Cavernous sinus thrombosis can cause similar imaging, but sinus opacification and immunosuppression point to fungal invasion rather than primary thrombosis.
GPA can involve sinuses and orbit, but lacks systemic features and the acute progressive course with immunosuppression favors infection.
